description: A 12-panel composite of bright-field TEM micrographs of 8Al steel, each panel carrying a small SAED inset, arranged by engineering strain. (a–c) 3 %: (a) austenite (γ) with planar dislocation lines and cross-slip, inset indexed (111), (002), (1̄1̄1) about [110]γ; (b) ferrite (α) with a red-boxed region labelled "Slip band" and a dashed trace along a (112)-type plane, inset [110]α with yellow-dashed DO3 superlattice spots; (c) a 200 nm magnified view labelling "Edge", "Mixed" and "Screw" dislocations along red dashed traces. (d, e) 10 %: more pronounced cross-slip in γ and evolving α slip bands. (f–h) 20 %: (f) γ "Dislocation cell blocks" outlined in white dashes; (g) γ "Dislocation cells" circled in dashes (inset (022), (020), (002), [100]γ); (h) refined α slip bands. (i–l) 28 %: (i) γ cell blocks, (j) γ cells, (k) γ "Twins" arrowed, with twin/matrix SAED spots, (l) α crossed dashed slip traces. All scale bars are 500 nm except (c) at 200 nm. No numeric values are printed beyond strain percentages; the group documents progressive refinement from planar slip to cell blocks/cells in austenite and slip-band refinement with cross-slip in ferrite.

observations.observation: The group is a 12-panel bright-field TEM composite of 8Al steel, panels labelled (a)–(l), all with 500 nm scale bars except (c) which is 200 nm.

Every panel contains an inset SAED pattern; the austenite insets are indexed with γ reflections such as (111), (002), (1̄1̄1) about a [110]γ zone axis, and in (g) and (j) (022), (020), (002) about [100]γ.
The ferrite panels (b, e, h, l) show SAED insets containing α reflections plus additional DO3 superlattice spots enclosed by yellow dashed lines.
Panel (c) annotates individual dislocation characters as 'Edge' (blue), 'Mixed' (magenta) and 'Screw' (red) along red dashed dislocation traces at 200 nm.
Panels (f) and (i) are annotated 'Dislocation cell blocks' and (g) and (j) 'Dislocation cells' in austenite at 20 % and 28 % strain, marked with white dashed outlines and circles respectively.
Panel (k) labels 'Twins' with white arrows and its inset shows extra diffraction spots beside the matrix reflections, consistent with a twin/matrix pattern.
Panels (h) and (l) show ferrite at 28 % strain with multiple parallel dashed white slip-band traces, and (l) contains two crossing dashed traces indicating cross-slip.
The caption assigns (a, d, f, g, i–k) to austenite and (b, c, e, h, l) to ferrite in 8Al steel, with strains (a–c) 3 %, (d, e) 10 %, (f–h) 20 % and (i–l) 28 %.

At 3 % engineering strain, planar dislocation slip along slip planes and distinct cross-slip are observed in the austenite, while the ferrite is primarily characterised by a planar dislocation structure.

Edge dislocations, mixed dislocations and long straight screw dislocations are reported to be activated in the ferrite of 8Al steel, forming slip bands, which differs from the local screw dislocations in ferrite of 10Al steel.

At 20 % engineering strain dislocation cell blocks and dislocation cells are reported to form in the austenite while the ferrite slip bands refine further; at 28 % these substructures are further refined.
A small number of deformation twins is reported to form at 28 % engineering strain due to the localisation of stress.
Both edge and screw dislocations in 8Al steel and 10Al steel are reported to show distinct planar slip, attributed to dislocation–ordered-structure interaction.

subfigures.description: Bright-field TEM of 3 % strained austenite with planar dislocation lines, cross-slip, a dashed white slip-plane trace and a 500 nm scale bar; inset SAED indexed (111), (002), (1̄1̄1) with [110]γ zone axis.

Bright-field TEM of 3 % strained ferrite; red dashed box labelled 'Slip band', dashed white trace along a (112)-type plane, 500 nm scale bar; inset [110]α pattern with yellow-dashed DO3 superlattice reflections.
200 nm magnified view of ferrite at 3 % strain; individual dislocations marked along red dashed lines and annotated 'Edge' (blue), 'Mixed' (magenta) and 'Screw' (red).
Bright-field TEM of 10 % strained austenite showing dense tangled dislocations with pronounced cross-slip, dashed slip-plane trace, 500 nm scale bar; inset γ SAED pattern.
Bright-field TEM of 10 % strained ferrite with long 'Slip band' structure, 500 nm scale bar; inset α pattern with DO3 spots marked by yellow dashes.
Bright-field TEM of 20 % strained austenite labelled 'Dislocation cell blocks', white dashed polygons outlining cell blocks, 500 nm scale bar; inset γ SAED pattern.
Bright-field TEM of 20 % strained austenite labelled 'Dislocation cells', dashed white circles marking cells, 500 nm scale bar; inset SAED indexed (022), (020), (002) about [100]γ.
Bright-field TEM of 28 % strained ferrite with refined slip bands marked by parallel dashed white lines, 500 nm scale bar; inset α/DO3 SAED pattern.
Bright-field TEM of 28 % strained austenite labelled 'Dislocation cell blocks' with small white dashed outlines, 500 nm scale bar; inset γ SAED pattern.
Bright-field TEM of 28 % strained austenite labelled 'Dislocation cells' with dashed circles, 500 nm scale bar; inset SAED indexed (022), (020), (002) about [100]γ.

Bright-field TEM of 28 % strained austenite with banded contrast and white arrows labelling 'Twins', 500 nm scale bar; inset SAED showing matrix reflections plus extra twin spots (indexed approximately (11-1)T, (111)M).
Bright-field TEM of 28 % strained ferrite with two crossing dashed white slip traces indicating cross-slip, 500 nm scale bar; inset [011]α pattern with DO3 spots marked by yellow dashes.

unreadable_items: Exact Miller indices of the dashed slip-plane traces in (a), (b), (d), (e), (h) and (l) are partly obscured by overbar typesetting (e.g. whether the trace is (111)γ or (1̄1̄1)γ is not certain).
The small SAED inset spot indices in (b), (e), (h) and (l) are rendered at low resolution and are only partially readable.
Twin/matrix spot indices in the (k) inset are legible only approximately (read as (11-1)T and (111)M).
